meta.description: 231 (stage U, U1e; the owner's decision of 2026-10-28): the bank statements process's invented statements, one packet per invented own party of configs/example_parties.json: each month's statement of its accounts as a bank's ISO 20022 camt.053 XML file, its balances and totals computed by code (jav/domains/finance/party_examples.py). Made by `python -m jav.cli examples --set bank_statements --write`; nothing in it is real.

changelog.note: 231 (U1e): the invented consultancy's four statements, March to June 2026.
